# Pinned toolchain for executing cookbook notebooks in CI.
# Shared by every language job in cookbook-validation.yml so a floating
# jupyter/nbconvert/pytest/nbmake release can't turn CI red independent of any
# cookbook change (and the weekly cron stays deterministic).
jupyter==1.1.1
nbconvert==7.17.1
pytest==8.3.5
nbmake==1.5.5
